designer_intent.notes: Create an uplifting West Coast hip-hop instrumental with a cinematic rise and fall. Use sample-based layering with sliced samples as texture beds and one-shot drum hits for rhythmic punctuation. Avoid typical melodic and harmonic writing; focus on arrangement and texture.

sensei_drum.brief: Generate and arrange one-shot drum hits to emphasize rhythmic groove and dynamic energy build and release.

bass_generator.brief: Create complementary low-end sample-based patterns that support the groove and match the cinematic energy profile.

harmony_generator.brief: Arrange sliced sample textures into harmonic beds that build cinematic atmosphere and uplift the mood.

melody_generator.brief: Incorporate minimalistic melodic motifs extracted from samples to subtly uplift without dominating the arrangement.

ai_designer.brief: Structure the arrangement with a cinematic rise and fall energy curve, balancing texture beds and one-shot hits in an instrumental format.

presetor.brief: Apply suitable reverb, delay, compression, and transient shaping presets optimized for West Coast hip-hop sample-based instrumental.

songgps.brief: Ensure arrangement follows the cinematic energy profile and maintains clear section transitions following ArrangementGPS protocols.

ai_mixmaster.brief: Prepare an unprocessed mix pass emphasizing dynamic contrast and clarity for both sample texture layers and one-shot drum hits.
